description: Paste comma- or tab-separated rows and get a clean Markdown table with your alignment choice.

faqs.a: If your text contains tabs they are used; otherwise commas separate the cells.
The first row becomes the header by default; toggle it off for data-only rows.
faqs.q: Is the first row the header?

faqs.a: Left, center or right — applied to every column.

howto: Paste rows (one per line, comma or tab separated).
Toggle header row and pick alignment.
Press Generate and copy the Markdown.
title: Markdown Table Generator
